; ======================================================================
; x509_blob.pi4 - T0 program blobs for 'X509', generated by tools/t0gen.py
;   DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Regenerate from the BearSSL-generated C.
;   source: x509_minimal.c
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
;   This file is PURE DATA: the .pico / .pico2 / .unor4 / .pi4 copies are
;   byte-identical below this header. It is loaded by the t0vm core;
;   include t0vm first, then this file, then call T0LoadX509().
;   Requires: t0vm (for the descriptor globals and #T0_NATIVE_BASE).
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
;   T0_INTERPRETED = 60   entry slot = 144   interpreted words = 139
;   code 2796 bytes   data 299 bytes   natives 29
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
;   HOW THE .pi4 COPY WAS PRODUCED, AND WHY IT IS A COPY.
;   tools/t0gen.py emits exactly one file and hard-codes its extension
;   to ".pico"; its own banner records the rule the families follow -
;   the per-family copies are byte-identical and are made by copying,
;   not by a second generator run. The .pi4 is the fourth such copy.
;   Regenerating for this extension was checked and is not available
;   here: the generator's input, x509_minimal.c, is not in this tree, and
;   tools/t0gen.py is not this worker's file to extend. The byte identity
;   is therefore GATED rather than trusted - tools/a64/a64_x509_check.py
;   compares this file below its header against RP2350/Lib/x509_blob.pico2
;   on every run and refuses to build if they differ. (Note for whoever
;   owns tools/check_t0vm_twins.py: its BLOB list covers pemdec_blob only
;   and still points at Examples/Verification, a directory that no longer
;   exists; it does not cover x509_blob on any family.)
; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
;   .i IS 64 BITS HERE. THE FOUR-SHAPE AUDIT, PLUS THE FIFTH.
;   Recorded per shape, because a silence is not a result. This file has
;   no arithmetic in it at all: it is 287 `Data.a` lines and one
;   procedure that assigns six label addresses to t0vm's descriptor
;   globals.
;     SHAPE 1 (an array element is eight bytes) - NOT PRESENT. There is
;       no Dim and no array. All four blobs are `Data.a`, ONE byte per
;       item on every family, and the caddr table is emitted as
;       little-endian 16-bit PAIRS OF BYTES for exactly that reason -
;       t0vm reads it two bytes at a time from a byte address, so no
;       element width anywhere can change under it.
;     SHAPE 2 (PeekL / PeekB sign-extend) - NOT PRESENT. This file
;       performs no read of any kind; t0vm does the reading, with PeekA.
;     SHAPE 3 (`<<` does not discard at bit 31) - NOT PRESENT. No shift,
;       no arithmetic operator at all.
;     SHAPE 4 (a 32-bit counter never wraps) - NOT PRESENT. No counter.
;     SHAPE 5 (`>> 31` as a sign test, `x ! $FFFFFFFF` as a logical NOT)
;       - NOT PRESENT. No `!`, no `>>`, and this file produces no
;       verdict. The six assignments in T0LoadX509 are `?label`
;       addresses, which are 64-bit here and 32-bit on a Pico, and the
;       t0_* globals they are stored into are `.i` on every family, so
;       the widening is exactly what is wanted.
; ======================================================================
